# <span id="aanchor161"></span> Required Meter Fields

Accessing this screen requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

The Required Fields screen allows administrators to configure specific fields so that populating them is required when a meter is created in the Meter Editor or through Meter Quick Create. If a user creates a meter with a tool, such as FcLoader, required Meter Editor fields may not be populated upon meter creation. However, the user will then be required to populate the required fields during subsequent edits in the Meter Editor. This does not affect edits in the Volume Editor.

If a field is designated as required, it will be highlighted in green, indicating that data is required before changes can be saved. If data is required, the field will be highlighted with green.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Required Fields screen and select required fields:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  In the **Application** group, select **Required Meter Fields**.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 359;height: 385;" />

3.  Click **Edit**.

4.  Select a category of fields to require (Meter Attributes or Meter Characteristics).

    Meter Characteristics fields correspond to the fields available on the Meter Quick Create screen, not the Volume Editor.

5.  Select the **Group** for which you want to view available fields.

6.  For each field that you want to require, click **Required**.

7.  When your selections are complete, click **Save**.

    If you select a field that is not available on the Meter Quick Create screen, a warning message will display stating that if you do not disable the Meter Quick Create form, it will be possible to create meters without the required field populated. In this situation, a **Disable Meter Quick Create** checkbox will display at the bottom of the Required Fields screen. If necessary, select the **Disable Meter Quick Create** option. 

</div>
